# betterado_area (Data Source)

Reads an area (classification node) from an Azure DevOps project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up the root area node (with children) for a project.
data "betterado_area" "root" {
  project_id     = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  fetch_children = true
}

# Look up a specific area path.
data "betterado_area" "sprint" {
  project_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  path       = "MyArea/SubArea"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project the area belongs to.

### Optional

- `fetch_children` (Boolean) Whether to fetch child nodes. Defaults to true.
- `path` (String) The path of the area node.

### Read-Only

- `children` (Attributes List) The child classification nodes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--children))
- `has_children` (Boolean) Whether the area node has children.
- `id` (String) The identifier of the classification node.
- `name` (String) The name of the area node.

<a id="nestedatt--children"></a>
### Nested Schema for `children`

Read-Only:

- `has_children` (Boolean) Whether the child classification node has children.
- `id` (String) The identifier of the child classification node.
- `name` (String) The name of the child classification node.
- `path` (String) The path of the child classification node.
- `project_id` (String) The project ID of the child classification node.
